name: Autodromo Nazionale Monza
sources: 3D circuit: 'Autodromo Nazionale Monza Circuit 2020 layout' by Tyler_Dave on Sketchfab (labelled CC Attribution; appears to be extracted from Assetto Corsa)
Centre line, widths, heights, banking, kerbs, run-off and barriers measured from that model, aligned to the TUMFTM racetrack-database centre line (LGPL-3.0)
Straight mode zones and overtake detection: FIA 2026 Italian Grand Prix circuit configuration (reported by GPFans and PlanetF1)

outright.note: pole lap, fastest average-speed lap in F1 history

approximations: Exact start and end metres of the four straight mode zones are not published; they are placed from corner exit to the braking area as the FIA describes them.
The measured centre line is 5.73 km, about 1% shorter than the official 5.793 km (smoothing on the straights and the measuring method).
Grid slot spacing is the standard 8 m; the slots may not line up exactly with the boxes painted in the 3D model.
straightModeZonesNote: FIA 2026: Zone 1 start/finish line to Turn 1; Zone 2 Curva Grande exit to Roggia; Zone 3 Lesmo 2 exit to Ascari; Zone 4 Ascari exit to Parabolica. Metres auto-fitted to corner braking points at load time when 'autoFit' is true.
